messages.author: 9defde66b07bc836
messages.subject: Plot outputs
parts:
Dear Nick,

I had some issues getting the outputs plotted with BiogeoBEARS. You managed to have the scripts running and forwarded me the outputs in PDFs a couple of days ago. As you can see in the PDF attached, the tree is quite large and details cannot be extracted from the figure. I tried running again the script you sent me but I still run on the same issue. I was wondering if you could please plot again the DEC results in a readable size (increasing the size of the PDF and decreasing cexs?)?
I have tried myself with no success. Thanks a lot for your time and I look forward to your reply,
Best
Yanis
